# Josie Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## Appearance

She has a family resemblance to the Pyes and wears dresses with flounces.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)_

## Personality

Josie is defiant, disagreeable, and quick to mock or criticize others. She often displays an aggravating, pitying attitude and lacks sympathy or imagination, though she possesses a natural physical dexterity when challenged.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

## Traits

- Disagreeable  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Defiant  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011)</sub>
- Cheating in class  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)</sub>
- Lacks imagination  <sub>[v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)</sub>

## Abilities

- Walking board fences with natural balance and skill  <sub>[v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>
- Knitting lace  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025)</sub>

## Goals

- Attend Queen's Academy and complete her studies  <sub>[v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)</sub>

## History

Josie attended Avonlea School alongside Anne Shirley and her classmates. During a class spelling turn, Anne caught Josie peeping in her book to spell a word, causing Anne to flash her a look of scorn. On another occasion, Josie engaged in a game of daring in the Barry garden, successfully walking a board fence before daring Anne to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's kitchen roof. After Anne accepted the dare and fell off the roof breaking her ankle, Josie later visited her during her recovery. She eventually prepared for and took the entrance examinations for Queen's Academy alongside her classmates, staying in town and pursuing her studies at the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c23 P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006), [v1 c23 P11](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0011), [v1 c23 P15](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0015), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016), [v1 c34 P19](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0019)_

- Attended Avonlea School as a classmate of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, Jane Andrews, and Ruby Gillis  <sub>[v1 c15 P25](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0025), [v1 c23 P2](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0002), [v1 c32 P16](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0016)</sub>
- Belongs to the Pye family of Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c15 P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026), [v1 c34 P17](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0017)</sub>
